title: fastpath: gated fastpath + precision-toggle + safe-mode fallback for KV-batched workloads and scheduler integration
author: Ava Chen
release_notes:
- Adds gated fastpath with precision toggle and safe-mode fallback for KV-batched workloads
- Integrates fastpath gating with continuous batching scheduler to reduce incorrect speculative fastpath usage
- Adds regression and perf tests; p99 latency improvements for inference-heavy KV workloads
- Runtime flags to opt into precision toggle and safe-mode checks
description:
Motivation: Some workloads (KV-batched + long context) saw correctness regressions when the new fastpath kernels were used aggressively. This PR introduces a gated fastpath with a runtime precision toggle and a lightweight safe-mode correctness checker. The goal is to get the majority of the perf benefits while ensuring identical outputs (or safe fallback) for correctness-sensitive requests.

Summary of changes: implements a fastpath gating layer that consults request metadata and runtime heuristics before selecting the optimized kernel; introduces a precision toggle (configurable per-model and per-route) that allows switching between fp16/bf16 kernels at inference time; adds a safe-mode detector that performs on-the-fly checksum and small-sample comparisons for early detection of divergence and triggers deterministic fallback to the slowpath when violations are observed. The gating also interacts with the continuous batching scheduler so we avoid placing correctness-sensitive inferences on speculative batches.

Checklist:
- [x] Add gated fastpath selection and kernel abstraction points
- [x] Implement precision toggle and propagate through model config and API
- [x] Add safe-mode checker (lightweight sampling + checksum) and deterministic fallback path
- [x] Integrate gating with KV cache and continuous batching scheduler
- [x] Add unit and integration tests covering correctness and fallback behavior
- [x] Run perf canary and validate p50/p95/p99 improvements on target workloads
- [x] Add config flags and docs for opt-in rollout

Design notes and tradeoffs: The safe-mode checker samples a small subset of tokens (configurable) and computes a fast rolling hash of the output token logits to detect divergence. This adds a small CPU cost; the design prioritizes low false negatives (i.e., detect incorrect kernels quickly) even if it means occasional false positives that cause fallback. The precision toggle allows teams to prefer bf16 for numerical stability on models that exhibit sensitivity; switching to bf16 on the fastpath reduces divergence incidents but gives up some of the fp16 kernel speed. Gating heuristics include model type, sequence length, kv-cache hit-rate, and recent divergence history. The scheduler uses these hints to avoid speculative co-batching of safe-mode requests with highly optimized batches.

Rollout plan: feature gated by runtime flags (flags.fastpath.enabled, flags.fastpath.precision_mode, flags.fastpath.safe_mode_sampling_rate). Start with small percentage rollout (5%), monitor divergence_count, fallback_rate, and latency percentiles. If safe-mode triggers become rare and p99 latency improves, increase rollout.

Related: linear ENG-6124 (fastpath rollout), ENG-6189 (kv-batching correctness incidents). See docs: /docs/fastpath.md and /specs/fastpath-precision-safe-mode.md for design specifics.

high_level_changes:
- New fastpath gating layer with kernel registry abstractions
- Precision toggle via model config and runtime flags
- Safe-mode checker that triggers deterministic fallback to slowpath
- Scheduler heuristics to avoid co-batching safety-sensitive requests
- Tests and canary perf harness additions
review_comments: Ethan Park (2026-02-11): Overall looks solid. Two requests: 1) make sampling rate configurable per-model and surface it in model metadata; 2) please add a short-circuit path to skip safe-mode sampling when a prior run for the same model+route had 0 divergences for the last 24h.

Ava Chen (2026-02-11): Addressed both comments: added model-level sampling_rate and a runtime cache 'safe_mode_recent_ok' that bypasses sampling when stability observed. See safe_mode_checker.h and flags.fastpath.yaml.

Maya Patel (2026-02-12): Found a potential race in kv_cache when updating last_used timestamps during fallback. Suggest using the cache's update API with lock.
Ava Chen (2026-02-12): Reworked kv_cache update to use update_last_used_locked() and added unit test for concurrent fallback scenarios.

Luca Rossi (2026-02-13): Perf concern: the rolling-hash can add CPU overhead on high throughput paths. Can we make the checker offloaded to a background thread pool?
Ava Chen (2026-02-13): Made sampling and checksum optional background tasks (configurable). Default keeps it inline for deterministic failure detection; added background mode flag and implementation with bounded worker pool.

Maya Patel (2026-02-14): Approving after verifying tests and perf canary results. Left small nits in doc wording. Approved.
Ethan Park (2026-02-15): Approved.

additional_context: Observed incidents prompting this change: INT-325 'kv-cache divergence on gpt-6b-like models' - root cause: aggressive fp16 kernel in fastpath. This PR mitigates by defaulting to safer configurations and adding deterministic fallback. See linear ENG-6124 for incident timeline.
